Title: Tanay's Day

Cast

1. Tanay - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Pallavi - 40 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Aditya - 10 years, friend
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
4. Riya - 8 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Tanay stands in the living room. Pallavi stands near him.]

Tanay: "What lovely weather!"

[Tanay knocks on the door.]

Tanay: "That was fun!"

[Tanay opens the door and goes out.]

Pallavi: "Yes, all right."

[Tanay slams the door shut.]

Tanay: "Careful!"

[Tanay opens the window.]

Tanay: "That was such a fun day!"
